title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Moderation and Compliance Executive
description:
📍 Remote / London

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We’re an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Content volume is rising fast, and automated detection handles a growing share of low-risk cases. The work that matters most is still human-led: high-risk decisions where context and judgement matter. This role helps keep creators and fans safe, improves policy and tooling through real-world feedback, and keeps us audit-ready as we scale.

🎯 The Role

We’re hiring a Moderation & Compliance Executive to protect platform integrity by reviewing content, investigating violations, and making fast, fair decisions at scale. You’ll report to our Moderation Manager as part of the Trust & Safety team.

This is an overnight role: 2am to 9am UK time, Tuesday to Saturday. We’re fully remote. If those hours fall in your normal working day where you’re based, even better.

🚀 What You’ll Do

  • Review and action user-generated content against Fanvue’s content and community guidelines

  • Investigate Terms of Service violations (explicit content policy breaches, impersonation, copyright claims/DMCA, off-platform risks)

  • Work moderation queues in our tooling, prioritising by risk and turnaround time

  • Escalate high-risk and edge cases to the Moderation Manager and Head of Trust & Safety, with clear decision notes

  • Spot patterns and emerging risks, and feed insights back into policy and tooling improvements

  • Keep clean records of decisions to support audits, compliance reviews, and appeals

  • Partner with Support and Creator teams on escalations involving account restrictions or compliance concerns

  • Cover the overnight shift reliably and handle sensitive content with consistency, empathy, and fairness

👀 Who You Are

  • 2+ years in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or compliance (ideally in UGC, social, or platform environments)

  • Strong judgement and fast decision-making on grey-area cases

  • Clear written communication, high discretion, and calm handling of sensitive content

  • Comfortable using tools like Slack, Notion, Intercom, Retool (or similar)

  • Valuable: moderation frameworks, DMCA workflows, Online Safety Act, EU Digital Services Act, platform TOS enforcement

  • Comfortable reviewing adult-only (18+) content

✨ You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You like high-signal operations work and making principled decisions quickly

  • You care about fairness, consistency, and auditability, not just queue volume

  • You can handle edge cases without freezing, and escalate cleanly when needed

  • You enjoy improving systems (templates, tags, decision notes) as well as executing

⚠️ You’ll Struggle Here If

  • You need rigid rules for every decision

  • You are uncomfortable with adult content

  • You can’t commit to regular overnight hours

  • You avoid accountability for decisions and documentation quality

  • You need close supervision to stay on track

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don’t just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Real input into policy, tooling, and how Trust & Safety operates day-to-day, with strong engineering support and a tight loop from operations to product

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it’s core to our product and how we work

  • Fully remote

  • High annual leave flexibility

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we’re actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

  • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

  • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

  • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

  • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

  • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

  • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

  • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

  • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

  • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

  • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

  • Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

  • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

  • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

  • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

  • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

  • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

  • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

  • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

  • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

  • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

  • Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

  • Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

  • CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

  • Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

  • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations

  • Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

  • Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

  • Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers?

  • Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

  • Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

  • Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

  • 25 days paid vacation per year.

  • Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

  • Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

This role exists because we have a growing book of SMB accounts that need a dedicated, consistent point of contact. As our Customer Success Associate, you’ll drive broad-stroke outreach and build the workflows to manage them well. You'll carry a book of 120+ accounts with roughly $2M in ARR, and your job is to make sure those customers are engaged, getting value, and set up for renewal. This is an entry-level role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp into the commercial side of the work. What You'll Do • Own the day-to-day relationship for your book of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and keeping customers informed, engaged, and successful on the platform • Contribute ideas to dashboards and workflows to track your book of business - renewal timelines, health signals, engagement levels, and expansion indicators - so nothing falls through the cracks • With guidance of leadership, drive outreach to customers ahead of renewal, lead those conversations, handle objections, and negotiate terms on flat renewals and smaller expansions, looping in Sales when a meaningful expansion opportunity emerges. • Track and forecast your renewal book on a rolling basis, proactively surfacing risks and creating plans to address them before they become problems • Use product usage data and customer outcomes to demonstrate value in renewal conversations and ongoing check-ins • Identify opportunities for feature adoption and product expansion within accounts, and flag those signals to the Sales team to build expansion pipeline • Gather and synthesize customer feedback and share it with Product and internal stakeholders to inform roadmap decisions and improve the customer experience • Work closely with senior CS teammates and your manager to develop your skills in account management, commercial negotiation, and customer communication What You'll Bring • Some experience in a customer-facing role - you can explain things simply, listen well, and adapt your approach to different audiences • An interest in building a career in customer success, and curiosity about the commercial side of the business - including how renewals work, how contracts are structured, and how value gets communicated to customers • You’re based in the Denver, Colorado area and are comfortable working remotely while participating in occasional in-person meetings and engagement with Denver-based stakeholders. This Role is a Great Fit If • You're energized by building relationships and want to be the person customers actually look forward to hearing from • You thrive when you have ownership over a defined body of work and the freedom to figure out how to make it run better • You enjoy the process of organizing complexity - tracking multiple accounts, spotting patterns, and keeping everything moving without things slipping • You're drawn to roles where you learn by doing, and you're comfortable asking questions and taking feedback as you develop your skills • You get excited about connecting customers to features or capabilities they didn't know they needed, and seeing that translate into real adoption • You work well within a team structure and are looking for mentorship, but you also want to take real ownership rather than just support someone else's book Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? title: Working Student IT Operations (f/m/d)
description:
Short Description

SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce.

You'll work hands-on with SPREAD's IT operations: Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and our Mac fleet. You'll need to get a real read on where things stand today, tighten up what's loose, and build the habits and documentation that keep it that way going forward. You own identity, endpoint, and device administration directly, handle end-user support and the full joiner-mover-leaver process, and work closely with InfoSec on the security requirements IT operations needs to meet.

Your Mission

  • Administer Entra ID day to day, including accounts, groups, access assignments, and SSO/MFA configuration, cleaning up anything that doesn't look right rather than assuming it's correct.
  • Own the full joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, including passing through existing accounts to close out anything stale or orphaned.
  • Manage the Mac fleet end to end: enrollment, configuration profiles, patching, and device lifecycle from procurement through secure retirement.
  • Keep an accurate asset inventory of who has what, including warranty and lease status.
  • Run first- and second-line end-user support, triaging and resolving tickets in Jira and building the self-service habits that keep the queue manageable.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange: mailboxes, distribution lists, licensing, and SharePoint/Teams permissions.
  • Keep the compliance platform (Vanta) current from the IT side, resolving integration drift and keeping evidence fresh for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX audits.

Your Experience

  • Real hands-on experience administering Entra ID and Microsoft 365, from a prior internship, working-student role, or coursework with genuine lab practice, not classroom theory alone.
  • Light scripting and automation instinct, such as Claude Code or n8n.
  • Comfortable auditing and tightening up an existing setup, not just maintaining a clean baseline handed to you on day one.
  • Comfort troubleshooting everyday end-user issues and owning a ticket queue end to end.
  • Exposure to Mac fleet or MDM management specifically.
  • Basic ISO 27001 or audit-support experience, even as part of a team or through training
  • Comfortable completing a background check and signing a confidentiality agreement, given this role's access to company systems and accounts.
  • Based in Berlin and able to work on-site.
  • German at B2 level or above, and fluent English.

Why SPREAD?

  • Take real ownership of IT systems that need real attention, not a shadowing or ticket-queue-only role.
  • Work directly with InfoSec and see how a real ISO 27001/SOC 2/TISAX program operates from the inside.
  • Flexible hours built around your studies.
  • Senior team prioritizing craft and accountability over hierarchy.
  • Berlin office with meals provided 3 times a week.

title: Prescriptions Support Coordinator
description:
At Montu, we are on a mission to transform access to medical cannabis treatment across the UK, and we are growing fast!

We are looking for a Prescription Support Coordinator to join our team in King's Cross, London. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy, fast-paced environment, has exceptional attention to detail and enjoys being part of a team that makes a genuine difference to patients' lives.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience. What matters most is your ability to work accurately, stay organised and bring a positive, proactive approach to everything you do.

If you are looking to be part of an ambitious, growing business where your work really matters, we would love to hear from you!

About the Role

As a Prescription Support Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our prescription operations, ensuring patient requests are reviewed accurately, processed efficiently and managed in line with our established procedures.

You will be responsible for reviewing a high volume of prescription requests, contacting patients to discuss alternative prescription quantities and ensuring their preferences are accurately recorded.

Working closely with our clinical and operational teams, you will help keep our prescription processes running smoothly while delivering a positive and professional patient experience.

This is a fast-paced, process-driven role that requires excellent attention to detail, consistency and the ability to maintain accuracy when completing repetitive tasks.

While you will not be making clinical decisions, you will need the confidence to recognise when something requires clinical input and escalate appropriately.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Reviewing and processing a high volume of prescription requests, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established procedures.

  • Contacting patients by telephone, email or messaging platforms to discuss alternative prescription quantities and accurately record their preferences.

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date patient records across internal systems.

  • Identifying discrepancies, unusual requests or queries requiring clinical input and escalating these to the appropriate pharmacist or prescriber.

  • Working closely with clinical and operational colleagues to ensure prescription requests progress efficiently.

  • Monitoring outstanding requests and following up where necessary to minimise delays to patient care.

  • Following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and identifying opportunities to improve existing processes.

  • Handling sensitive patient information confidentially and in accordance with GDPR.

  • Delivering clear, professional and compassionate communication to patients.

  • Working towards daily and weekly productivity and accuracy targets while maintaining high standards of quality.

What You Will Need

We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a busy environment, has a natural eye for detail and takes pride in getting things right.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience in administration, data entry, customer support or another process-driven role where accuracy is essential.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration when completing repetitive, high-volume tasks.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.

  • A practical, solutions-focused approach with the confidence to recognise when an issue needs escalating.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a friendly and professional approach to patient interactions.

  • Confidence using computer systems, databases and spreadsheets, with the ability to learn new platforms quickly.

  • A commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive information appropriately.

  • A proactive, reliable and adaptable approach to working within a growing business.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Previous experience working within healthcare, pharmacy or a patient-focused environment.

  • An understanding of prescription processes or medical terminology.

  • Experience handling confidential patient information and an understanding of GDPR within healthcare.

Previous pharmacy experience is not essential. We are more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, excellent attention to detail and a genuine commitment to delivering a great patient experience.

What We Offer

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients' lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £28K
